title: Les changements orthographiques au futur
summary: Manage `e/è`, doubled consonants and `y/i`, including accepted traditional and revised spellings.
objectives: Recognize and accept both taught spelling variants.

sources.label: OQLF: conditional stems and future/conditional spelling variants

sections.title: The changed stem stays changed for all persons
paragraphs: An unaccented `e` in stems such as `lever` and `acheter` becomes `è` before the future ending: `lèver-, achèter-`. `Geler` gives `gèler-`, `mener` gives `mèner-` and `peser` gives `pèser-`. `Appeler` and `jeter` instead keep a doubled consonant: `appeller-, jetter-`. Their derivatives `rappeler` and `rejeter` keep that pattern.

These changes apply to every future person, including `nous` and `vous`. Use the full future endings `-ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont` after the displayed stem. Thus `jeter` gives `je jetterai, tu jetteras, il/elle/on jettera, nous jetterons, vous jetterez, ils/elles jetteront`; `lever` gives `je lèverai, tu lèveras, il/elle/on lèvera, nous lèverons, vous lèverez, ils/elles lèveront`.
points: Vocabulary: `une étiquette` (feminine), a label; `une étagère` (feminine), a shelf.
Not every `-eter` verb doubles `t`: `acheter` is `achèter-`, not `acheterr-` or `achetter-`.

examples.french:
j'**achèterai**
tu **achèteras**
il/elle/on **achètera**
nous **achèterons**
vous **achèterez**
ils/elles **achèteront**
examples.english:
I will buy
you will buy (singular)
he/she/one will buy
we will buy
you will buy (plural or polite)
they will buy
examples.note: The grave accent remains in all six forms.

examples.french:
j'**appellerai**
tu **appelleras**
il/elle/on **appellera**
nous **appellerons**
vous **appellerez**
ils/elles **appelleront**
examples.english:
I will call
you will call (singular)
he/she/one will call
we will call
you will call (plural or polite)
they will call
examples.note: The doubled `l` remains even with `nous` and `vous`.

examples.french: Nous **lèverons** les stores à huit heures.
examples.english: We will raise the blinds at eight o'clock.
examples.note: Unlike present `nous levons`, future `nous lèverons` has `è`.

examples.english: You will throw away the damaged labels.

mistakes.why: The future stem `achèter-` keeps `è` with `nous` too.

sections.title: Two spelling traditions can both be correct
paragraphs: For verbs with `é` before the final consonant, traditional future spelling keeps `é`: `préférerai, répéterai, compléterai`. The 1990 rectifications permit `è` there: `préfèrerai, répèterai, complèterai`. Both are correct. Apply the chosen stem to every person: `préférerai/préfèrerai, préféreras/préfèreras, préférera/préfèrera, préférerons/préfèrerons, préférerez/préfèrerez, préféreront/préfèreront`.

Many `-eler` and `-eter` verbs traditionally double the consonant but can use `è` under the rectifications: `épeler` gives `épellerai` or `épèlerai`; `renouveler` gives `renouvellerai` or `renouvèlerai`; `étiqueter` gives `étiquetterai` or `étiquèterai`. The alternatives persist with all six endings. `Appeler`, `jeter` and their derivatives are exceptions to that simplification: `appellerai` and `jetterai` remain the forms, not `appèlerai` or `jèterai`.
points: A chosen spelling convention should be reasonably consistent, but either accepted form is valid in these exercises.
This spelling choice does not change tense, person or meaning.

examples.french: Tu **préféreras / préfèreras** peut-être le modèle pliable.
examples.english: You may prefer the folding model.
examples.note: Traditional and revised spelling are both shown.

examples.french: Elle **épellera / épèlera** son nom au téléphone.
examples.english: She will spell her name over the phone.
examples.note: Both spellings are accepted; the choice is not a difference in meaning.

sections.title: `Y` becomes `i`, except that `-ayer` offers a choice
paragraphs: For `-oyer` and `-uyer` verbs, use `i` in the future stem: `nettoyer` gives `nettoier-`, `employer` `emploier-`, `essuyer` `essuier-` and `appuyer` `appuier-`. `Envoyer` and `renvoyer` are special: `enverr-` and `renverr-`, taught in the future outcomes lesson.

For `-ayer` verbs, both `i` and `y` are accepted: `payer` gives `paier-` or `payer-`; `essayer` gives `essaier-` or `essayer-`. `Payer`'s full forms are `je paierai/payerai, tu paieras/payeras, il/elle/on paiera/payera, nous paierons/payerons, vous paierez/payerez, ils/elles paieront/payeront`. Do not transfer this optional `y` to `nettoyer` or `essuyer`.
points: `Essuyer` follows the six endings without any other change: `j'essuierai, tu essuieras, il/elle/on essuiera, nous essuierons, vous essuierez, ils/elles essuieront`.

examples.french:
je **nettoierai**
tu **nettoieras**
il/elle/on **nettoiera**
nous **nettoierons**
vous **nettoierez**
ils/elles **nettoieront**
examples.english:
I will clean
you will clean (singular)
he/she/one will clean
we will clean
you will clean (plural or polite)
they will clean

examples.french: Vous **essuierez** le comptoir après le service.
examples.english: You will wipe the counter after service.

mistakes.why: Unlike `-ayer`, `-oyer` normally requires `i` in the future stem.

practice.prompt: Supply acheter in the simple future: Vous ___ du matériel.
practice.explanation: Achèter- keeps è with vous.

practice.prompt: Supply appeler in the simple future: Nous ___ le fournisseur.
practice.explanation: Appeler retains doubled l.

practice.prompt: Supply répéter in the simple future: Elle ___ la consigne. Either standard spelling is accepted.
practice.explanation: Traditional é and rectified è are both valid.

practice.prompt: Supply payer in the simple future: Je ___ par carte. Either variant is accepted.
practice.explanation: -Ayer allows both i and y.

practice.prompt: Supply lever in the simple future: Nous ___ la main.
practice.explanation: Use future lèver-, not present lev-.

practice.prompt: Supply jeter in the simple future: Tu ___ le brouillon.
practice.explanation: Jeter retains tt in both spelling conventions.

practice.prompt: Supply préférer in the simple future: Ils ___ attendre. Either standard spelling is accepted.
practice.explanation: Both future stems are accepted.

practice.prompt: Supply renouveler in the simple future: Vous ___ votre inscription. Either standard spelling is accepted.
practice.explanation: Traditional ll alternates with rectified è plus single l.

practice.prompt: Supply nettoyer in the simple future: Elles ___ les vitres.
practice.explanation: Nettoyer requires i in this stem.

practice.prompt: Supply essuyer in the simple future: J'___ la table.
practice.explanation: -Uyer changes y to i.

practice.prompt: Supply essayer in the simple future: Nous ___ une autre méthode. Either variant is accepted.
practice.explanation: Essayer allows both future spellings.

practice.prompt: Supply étiqueter in the simple future: Tu ___ les boîtes. Either standard spelling is accepted.
practice.explanation: Traditional tt or rectified è plus t are valid.

practice.prompt: Supply rappeler in the simple future: Elle ___ le client.
practice.explanation: Rappeler retains appeler's doubled l.

practice.prompt: Supply épeler in the simple future: Nous ___ le nom. Either standard spelling is accepted.
practice.explanation: Both the traditional and revised stems take -ons.

practice.prompt: Supply appuyer in the simple future: Vous ___ sur le bouton vert.
practice.explanation: The future stem is appuier-.

practice.prompt: Supply mener in the simple future: Ils ___ l'enquête.
practice.explanation: Mener changes its stem e to è.

practice.prompt: Supply geler in the simple future: Cette eau ___ pendant la nuit.
practice.explanation: Geler changes e to è, without doubling l.

practice.prompt: Supply peser in the simple future: Nous ___ les colis avant l'envoi.
practice.explanation: The è remains in the future even with nous.

practice.prompt: Supply rejeter in the simple future: Ils ___ les dossiers incomplets.
practice.explanation: Rejeter retains jeter's double t in both spelling conventions.

practice.prompt: Supply compléter in the simple future: Vous ___ le formulaire. Either standard spelling is accepted.
practice.explanation: Traditional é and revised è are both valid in the future stem.

practice.prompt: Supply employer in the simple future: L'équipe ___ une autre méthode.
practice.explanation: -Oyer changes y to i; it does not share payer's optional y.

production_task.prompt: Plan the reopening of a small shop in four sentences. Include an accent-changing future, a doubled-consonant future, an `-oyer/-uyer` future and an `-ayer` future. Choose either accepted spelling where alternatives exist.
production_task.model_answer: Nous achèterons de nouvelles étagères. J'appellerai le peintre lundi. Vous nettoierez les vitres avant l'ouverture. Nous paierons la facture après les travaux.
production_task.translation: We will buy new shelves. I will call the painter on Monday. You will clean the windows before opening. We will pay the invoice after the work.
rubric: Keep each changed stem throughout its form.
Use a coherent spelling convention without rejecting valid alternatives.
Make the sequence of jobs understandable.
